ck: ranasupa_25 ( ra . ) yatu sa cayatirtatika purvotaraviruta anyata ceti sutrapatasya yatapeksayetyakanksasantyartan vaksyananapeteneti lekanena tasakitavatitvanatiyata ityansakrhita tasakitavatisruterapetartatvanankikrtan anyatavaksyananapetapeksayeti lekananupapate ante vapetastane ansatvan vaktavyaniti lekanenapetanirtesasyansatvartatvanuktaniti atyantavirotatiti kantanan_25 (kan) tana kankayan kosa ityatra kankapatavacye pravahe kosatikaranatvapatat kankapatasya tirartatvan vaktavyanityukte purva pravaha kankapatapotya ityuktan itanin tiran kankapatapotyanityucyate ato virota iti vakturivapetastanensatvan vaktavyanityapetapotakataya pratiyananapatasyansartakatvanankikaraniyanityukte "prahnatasaprahnakitava " iti vakyena pratiyananapetapeksayetyuktinatrena tasyapetartatvanurarikrtaniti vicnaya virota iti vatatastavapyapahasaniyatvat
